# Legacy save regression fixture

`legacy-v021.coaster` is the accepted, immutable generator 0.2.1 seed 3 flat-terrain physics-proof design, captured before the packed-layout experiment. It uses the seven-field COASTER 2 operation grammar. SHA-256: `7f9bc3932ee6a877c3c5eb2599b10fa1f7b8af0800e353e65eab0fbf10515a00`.

Historical 0.3 tests replayed this file, compared numerical metrics and upgraded a temporary copy to COASTER 3 while checking canonical payload preservation. Its historical implicit station profile is 1.8 m/s² preferred deceleration and a 0.025 m stop offset.

The current COASTER5 runtime instead rejects this older schema explicitly. Permanent tests verify rejection, retention of the previously accepted design and byte-for-byte preservation of the archived fixture. Current-schema round-trip tests generate new geometry and verify explicit stopping and exit-fade fields; they do not migrate this historical file.

This fixture must remain generated by the legacy executable; regenerating it with the current algorithm would defeat the historical-schema rejection regression. The additional foundation/historical fixtures likewise preserve their original payloads and are not current successful-load examples.
